dedupe_keys.name: techno economic dataset for energy system modelling in indonesia 2015 2050

description: This data set gives techno-economic data and assumptions for energy system modelling in Indonesia for 2015 to 2050. It was published on Zenodo in December 2023 (version 1.0) by Laksmita Dwi Hersaputri under the Climate Compatible Growth programme, which is led from the STEER centre at Loughborough University and funded by UK aid, and was developed with the Energy Transition Council. It covers capital, fixed and variable costs, power plant operational life, capacity factors, demand, residual capacity, electricity production, and renewable energy supply and potential. Coverage is Indonesia at national level. The data are one Excel workbook of about 72 KB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the abstract does not give the sources of each value or any regional split across the archipelago, and the numbers reflect assumptions as of 2023. Simulation uses are parameterising least-cost power system expansion models such as OSeMOSYS for Indonesia. Related records: data-times-sweden-subres-technology-databases is a comparable techno-economic input set for another country.
